decisions.reason: Requiring a rationale for proposed question removals does not change the required or optional layers of answers.
The removal-rationale rule does not alter how international perspectives are integrated into the manuscript.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY requiring proposed removals to be made in suggesting mode with an explanatory comment; no edit or additional Event is needed.
The rationale requirement applies to curation of existing questions and does not change the AI chapter.
The rationale requirement applies to removing existing questions and does not change the chapter about questions candidates can ask interviewers.
The existing-question removal workflow does not change the content or length policy for the first-time leader chapter.
The rationale requirement for removed questions does not change the pre-interview preparation chapter.
The curation rationale rule does not alter the remote and hybrid leadership chapter.
The question-removal rationale requirement does not affect companion-resource delivery formats or content.
Documenting reasons for proposed removals does not change the 110,000-word ceiling or the recorded approximate length of the existing edition.
The question-curation rationale rule does not change the production-readiness standard for companion templates.
The rationale requirement for question removals does not affect video-script delivery or recording responsibility.
